parameters.content:
## Setup (do this once)
1. Open **Config** and fill `businessName`, `ownerEmail`, `calendarId`, `formUrl` (the production URL of **Start Form**) and `sheetId` (the long ID inside the Google Sheet link).
2. Pick a **Google Sheets** credential on the 6 Google Sheets nodes.
3. The sheet needs the tabs **Bookings**, **Services**, **Clients** with their header rows.
4. Opening hours, closed days and limits are all in **Config**.

## Book a new appointment + Change an appointment
Both use the same free-time check and the same save steps.

## Safety net
In this workflow open **Settings → Error workflow** and choose this same workflow. Also set `OWNER_EMAIL` inside **Build Error Alert**. Any error that was not handled by a node will email the owner.
